authority.plan: PLAN_crypto_v14.md sections 2 and 6 (P2 coverage-first and evidenced-availability rules)
authority.classification_rule: EVIDENCED_AVAILABLE = measured retrievable depth funds the stated conditioning clock over the blind-S0 screen window AND documented endpoint semantics/publication lag are archived; COVERAGE_INSUFFICIENT_FAIL_CLOSED = measured depth cannot fund the clock; ASSERTED_UNEVIDENCED = no measured+documented basis. Documentation claims never substitute for measured depth.

sources.classification_basis: relative to 5m and 15m conditioning clocks over 2025-08-22T00:00:00Z..2026-08-21T23:59:59Z: measured point anchors return rows exactly AT the screen start (2025-08-22T00:00Z, all 4 symbols, 5m and 15m) and at the screen end (2026-08-21 boundary, all 4 symbols, 5m); deeper brackets: row exists at 2024-08-20 (authorized start) and at 2023-01-01, absent at 2019-12-01; documented semantics for pair/contractType/period/limit archived. DOCUMENTED-VS-MEASURED DISCREPANCY: the page states 'Only the data of the latest 30 days is available.' but measured depth exceeds 3 years - classification proceeds on the measured bound with the documented bound recorded and the discrepancy flagged for D2 re-verification
